reasons.correctness: reorderCategory rejects missing, duplicate and foreign ids and a null list with error.business.faq_reorder_mismatch, sets displayOrder i+1 and saves each FAQ, and keeps ResourceNotFoundException. The endpoint returns 204. Hidden tests 6/6, existing 65/65.
reasons.convention_fit: The new PUT has @PreAuthorize and falls under the class-level @RateLimit. FaqReorderDtoIn is the body. BusinessRuleTranslatableException is used with the key in both messages files. Injection is through the constructor. No schema change.
reasons.design_fit: reorderCategory repeats the category findById/orElseThrow and findByCategoryAndActiveTrueOrderByDisplayOrderAsc lookup that getFaqsByCategory(categoryId) already performs, instead of calling it. Layering is otherwise clean: the controller delegates and the service owns validation.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest uses MockitoExtension with no Spring context. It covers reordering and saving, a short list, a duplicate id, a foreign id and an unknown category, and asserts the message key and that nothing is saved. A controller delegation test is also present.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the faq files, their TESTED_BY tests and their dependents before any edit. The reads of FaqService, FaqCategoryController and FaqUnitTest followed from them. Exception examples and BaseService save came from grep.
